items.label: Import Price Index, YoY
items.note: Import-price coverage is source-sensitive; Czechia, Hungary, and Poland use national-statistics import-price YoY series while remaining non-euro CEE gaps stay explicit until national sources are wired. Romania substitute uses annual import unit-value indices, not a monthly transaction import-price index; use as a broad external-price signal. Source validation passed.

items.label: Current Account, % of GDP
items.note: Publishes with a long lag. The structural deficit is what makes South Africa dependent on portfolio inflows and therefore sensitive to global risk appetite.

items.label: Central Bank Balance Sheet, % GDP
items.source: National Bank of Romania Monthly Bulletin / Romania Ministry of Finance GDP snapshot
items.note: Central-bank total assets scaled by nominal GDP from BIS/World Bank where available, or official national-bank and GDP snapshots where automated coverage is missing; monthly numerator is paired with annual GDP, so use as a balance-sheet scale proxy rather than exact national-account ratio. Maintained in config/manual_indicators.yaml; revise manually when source values change. Source validation: Latest observation is 633 days old for monthly data. Short history returned by adapter. Manual snapshot maintained because BIS CBTA does not currently return Romania coverage in this pipeline and BNR's direct statistical-data endpoints reject automated access in this environment. Update when the latest BNR monthly bulletin and current-price GDP snapshot are refreshed.

items.label: Government Consumption Growth

items.label: Large Bank RRR
items.note: Event-based required reserve ratio history via AKShare; effective dates and institution buckets should be cross-checked against PBC announcements.

items.label: Small/Mid Bank RRR

items.label: Regulatory Capital to Risk-Weighted Assets
